text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are here for a newborn assessment. Could you please describe the specific findings on the physical examination and any relevant history you have observed?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. Since the mother had no prenatal care, are there any visible physical anomalies such as facial dysmorphism, limb defects, or skin abnormalities on the newborn?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The combination of a continuous heart murmur (suggesting a Patent Ductus Arteriosus), chorioretinitis/cloudy lenses (suggesting congenital cataracts or glaucoma), hearing loss, and petechial rash ("blueberry muffin" lesions) in an infant with no prenatal care is highly suggestive of Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

REQUEST TEST: Rubella_IgM_antibodies

speaker: Doctor
text: The positive Rubella IgM antibodies confirm the clinical suspicion of Congenital Rubella Syndrome. DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome
